race.comment: ROTH AUTHORITY (4) sets the standard after consecutive Townsville thirds over 1609m, the latest a half-length defeat when near the top of an open market and pipped late in provincial company. He comes back to 1450m with that distance record still winless, but he has placed twice around the trip and is the most reliable winning profile. FARNANHEIT (2) brings the next-best recent run after making solid ground from well back for fourth at this track over 1250m, beaten two lengths after beginning slowly. His Home Hill run prior was poor on heavy ground, so the step to 1450m has to be treated with some caution. VOLARE (6) is better judged on her Bowen third as favourite two back than the Townsville tenth, where she jumped awkwardly, raced keenly and met interference. POWER CRUISE (3) is a more speculative inclusion: he was wide when sixth at Townsville and gets barrier 1 with Lacey Morrison, but his 0-from-16 record keeps the bar fairly high.
